---
title: "The claim ledger"
---

Every material research claim, typed and provenance-linked. Rendered directly
from `research/literature/claims.yaml` at publish time — this page cannot
drift from the ledger. Claims whose notes name a test file are re-verified by
CI on every push to the linked repo.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
spec <- yaml::read_yaml("../dataimago-spec.yaml")
app_repo <- sprintf("https://github.com/%s/%s", spec$user$githubUsername, spec$metadata$name)
rpkg_repo <- sub("\\.git$", "", spec$source$rPackage$submoduleUrl %||% app_repo)

ledger_path <- "../research/literature/claims.yaml"
if (!file.exists(ledger_path)) {
  cat("*No claim ledger yet — it is seeded when your AI assistant bootstraps",
      "the knowledge base (run /ingest — see KNOWLEDGE.md).*\n")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
ledger <- yaml::read_yaml(ledger_path)$claims

# Summary table
cat("| ID | Type | Scope | Risk | Verified |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n")
for (cl in ledger) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "| [%s](#%s) | %s | %s | %s | %s |\n",
    cl$claim_id, tolower(cl$claim_id), cl$claim_type, cl$scope, cl$risk_level,
    if (is.null(cl$verification_date)) "—" else as.character(cl$verification_date)
  ))
}
cat("\n")

for (cl in ledger) {
  cat(sprintf("## %s {#%s}\n\n", cl$claim_id, tolower(cl$claim_id)))
  cat(sprintf("> %s\n\n", trimws(cl$claim_text)))
  cat(sprintf("**Type:** `%s` · **Scope:** %s · **Risk:** %s · **Source quality:** %s\n\n",
              cl$claim_type, cl$scope, cl$risk_level, cl$source_quality))
  if (length(cl$source_ids) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "**Sources:** %s (see [the bibliography](%s/blob/main/research/literature/bibliography.bib))\n\n",
      paste(sprintf("`%s`", unlist(cl$source_ids)), collapse = ", "), app_repo))
  }
  if (!is.null(cl$verified_by)) {
    cat(sprintf("**Verified:** %s by `%s`\n\n", cl$verification_date, cl$verified_by))
  }
  if (!is.null(cl$notes)) {
    notes <- trimws(cl$notes)
    # Link any named test files to the R package repo (the CI provenance edge).
    tests <- regmatches(notes, gregexpr("tests/testthat/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\\.R", notes))[[1]]
    cat(sprintf("*%s*\n\n", notes))
    for (tf in unique(tests)) {
      cat(sprintf("→ Re-verified in CI: [`%s`](%s/blob/main/%s)\n\n", tf, rpkg_repo, tf))
    }
  }
}
```
